features.name: soil_moisture_percent
features.description: Volumetric soil water content measured in crop root zone.

features.name: rainfall_mm
features.description: Precipitation recorded over the preceding 24-hour observation window.

classes.0: No irrigation needed (Soil moisture adequate or recent rain)
classes.1: Irrigation recommended (Soil water deficit under atmospheric demand)

generation_logic.evaporative_demand_factor: Scaled product of temperature and dryness index
generation_logic.soil_deficit_factor: Moisture deficit relative to 36% field capacity
generation_logic.stochastic_noise: Gaussian perturbation std=0.06 plus 3.5% sensor/microclimate label flips

critical_honesty_notice: Good validation scores on synthetic rule-generated data reflect consistency with the mathematical generation assumptions. It does not establish real-world agricultural accuracy on physical crops or live farm microclimates.
